name: rules-classifier
title: Finding standing instructions in what a person types

conditions.sample: 1,000 typed turns, each labelled by the person as a standing instruction or not
conditions.source: the author's own session archive; only counts leave it

summary: A classifier proposes rules from a person's own turns; only the person accepts one. Matching cue words such as "always" and "never" is the baseline.
baseline: matching cue words such as "always" and "never"
meaning: A small model finds about five in six standing instructions; cue words find one in six. About a quarter of what it proposes is not a rule, which is why a person accepts or rejects each proposal.
